details: Added standard anyOf support to JsonSchemaValidator, a structured integer-or-object delete schema with required string id, validator regression cases, explicit set-schema assertion, and a standalone authenticated v2 read/set/delete sequence checking SolrJ serialization and persisted config. The handler's advertised spec is checked in-process; HTTP introspection and concurrent retries are not tested. Windows ran git diff --check only.
summary: Pushed review follow-up adding structured delete alternatives and public-boundary tests; Linux proof pending.
